claims.text: FTD, not a base, was the terminal analytical office: 'FTD will: (1) Analyze and evaluate all information and evidence reported to bases on those UFOs which are not identified at the base level', and 'FTD, Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, will prepare a final case report on each sighting reported to it.'

claims.sourceText: Air Force Regulation 80-17, 'Research and Development - UNIDENTIFIED FLYING OBJECTS (UFO)', Department of the Air Force, 19 September 1966, https://nicap.org/afr80-17.htm
claims.text: The Blue Book effort was assigned to FTD by regulation: 'The Air Force Systems Command will support the program with current resources within the Foreign Technology Division (FTD) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, to continue Blue Book effort.'

edges.label: Held the Blue Book effort by regulation from 19 September 1966
edges.note: AFR 80-17 assigns the Blue Book effort to FTD at Wright-Patterson, requires FTD to analyse every report not identified at base level, and requires FTD to write the final case report on each sighting.

edges.label: Air Force Systems Command organisation under the DCS/Research and Development for the UFO programme
edges.note: AFR 80-17 makes the Deputy Chief of Staff, Research and Development responsible for the overall programme and Air Force Systems Command responsible for supporting it through FTD.

edges.label: Stationed at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio
edges.note: AFR 80-17 names the station in the assignment itself: 'the Foreign Technology Division (FTD) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio'.
